content:
My greatest strength is helping you turn messy or complex information into clear, useful answers—whether that means explaining a concept, drafting text, solving a problem, comparing options, or organizing a plan.

I’m also strong at adapting to your needs: I can be concise, detailed, formal, creative, technical, or conversational depending on what you’re trying to do.
